package.name: amr_costmap_plugins
package.description: Nav2 costmap_2d layer plugins. FleetTrajectoryLayer stamps the other robots' predicted trajectories into each robot's LOCAL costmap with time-decayed cost, which is where the assignment's MAPF requirement (3.2) is satisfied: a robot's local planner consumes its peers' intentions directly rather than a central node handing out schedules. C++ because it runs at costmap update rate behind the pluginlib API. RampCostLayer is not here: the compressed delivery plan descopes ramp cost to a costmap filter mask, which the assignment permits verbatim.
